column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah 18 (M23018): Klukai membawa Komandan lolos; Cheyanne bertahan sendirian.
# Tetap Inggris: Klukai, Cheyanne, Wulfgar, Vasily, Lentine, Rommel, Sinbreaker,
# Squad 404, Monsoon Squad, Oathguards, Mokosh, Mangi Security, The Elmo, Griffin,
# Doll, Frame, Scorch Marks, Yellow Zone.
# Catatan: satu baris di file Inggris masih berbahasa Mandarin (呼—— = embusan napas).
(The black motorcycle was like a hurricane, speeding and crashing through the wilderness.)
column2: (Motor hitam itu bagai badai, melesat menerjang padang tandus.)

column1: (Klukai drove the motorcycle, constantly accelerating, but the bullets still pursued relentlessly.)
column2: (Klukai memacu motornya, terus menambah kecepatan, tapi peluru tetap mengejar tanpa ampun.)

column1: (A hail of bullets flies toward her, but Klukai doesn't dare to flexibly dodge like she used to.)
column2: (Hujan peluru melesat ke arahnya, tapi Klukai tak berani mengelak lincah seperti biasanya.)

column1: (Protected tightly in her arms, after experiencing explosions and bumps, the Commander remains unconscious, and warm blood is even faintly seeping out from under the layers of bandages.)
column2: (Terlindung erat dalam dekapannya, setelah melewati ledakan dan guncangan, Komandan masih tak sadarkan diri, dan darah hangat bahkan samar merembes dari balik lapisan perban.)

column1: (I can't let the Commander get hurt anymore...!)
column2: (Aku tidak boleh membiarkan Komandan terluka lagi...!)

column1: (Klukai activates her force field shield again, but the force field shield, which had already withstood several attacks, is out of energy, and quickly shatters under the impact of the bullets.)
column2: (Klukai kembali mengaktifkan perisai medan gayanya, tapi perisai yang sudah menahan beberapa serangan itu kehabisan energi dan cepat pecah dihantam peluru.)

column1: (The moment the firelight closes in, Klukai maneuvers the vehicle to spin, using her Frame to block the remaining bullets.)
column2: (Begitu kilatan tembakan mendekat, Klukai memutar kendaraannya, memakai Frame-nya untuk menahan sisa peluru.)

column1: (Pfft—! Pfft, pfft, pfft!)
column2: (Cras—! Cras, cras, cras!)

column1: (Scorching heat brushed past her cheek, countless sparks exploded on her body, and sharp metal shells drilled into her bionic skin, burning and tearing apart more than half of her body.)
column2: (Panas membara menyerempet pipinya, percikan tak terhitung meledak di tubuhnya, dan selongsong logam tajam menembus kulit bioniknya, membakar dan mencabik lebih dari separuh tubuhnya.)

column1: (But she didn't stop for a single second. The motorcycle was still accelerating. She braved the hail of bullets and raised her gun to shoot back, ignoring the barrel that was so hot it was about to burn, just constantly speeding, shooting back, speeding, shooting back—)
column2: (Tapi dia tidak berhenti sedetik pun. Motornya terus menambah kecepatan. Dia menerjang hujan peluru dan mengangkat senjatanya untuk membalas, tak peduli larasnya yang panas nyaris membakar, terus melaju, membalas, melaju, membalas—)

column1: (But no matter how fast she sped, the noisy sounds still chased behind her, making her annoyed.)
column2: (Tapi secepat apa pun dia melaju, suara berisik itu tetap mengejar di belakangnya dan membuatnya kesal.)

column1: That Doll... is carrying the enemy Commander!
column2: Doll itu... membawa Komandan musuh!

column1: Catch her! Stop them!
column2: Tangkap dia! Hentikan mereka!

column1: (Klukai threw a grenade, the overly large movement causing the person in her arms to tremble.)
column2: (Klukai melempar granat, gerakan yang terlalu besar itu membuat orang dalam dekapannya berguncang.)

column1: (Although she had already tied them with a safety strap in advance, Klukai still hurriedly hugged the Commander tighter.)
column2: (Meski dia sudah mengikatnya dengan sabuk pengaman sejak tadi, Klukai tetap buru-buru mendekap Komandan lebih erat.)

column1: (Commander...)
column2: (Komandan...)

column1: (Klukai couldn't help but glance into her arms.)
column2: (Klukai tak kuasa menahan diri untuk melirik ke dalam dekapannya.)

column1: (The person who has always been resolute and reliable, the person who has always fought against the storm side by side with her, the person who is always forced to separate and makes her worry, is right now leaning closely in her arms, so close that even every breath seems touchable.)
column2: (Orang yang selalu tegas dan bisa diandalkan, orang yang selalu menantang badai berdampingan dengannya, orang yang selalu terpaksa berpisah dan membuatnya cemas, saat ini bersandar rapat dalam dekapannya, begitu dekat sampai setiap embusan napasnya seakan bisa disentuh.)

column1: (But his breathing is so weak, his hair so messy, his forehead resting against her chest, covered in blood, dust, and sweat.)
column2: (Tapi napasnya begitu lemah, rambutnya begitu berantakan, keningnya bersandar di dadanya, berlumur darah, debu, dan keringat.)

column1: (Klukai raised her hand in the gap of acceleration, wanting to wipe those stains for the Commander, but frowned at the cold temperature the moment she touched the forehead.)
column2: (Klukai mengangkat tangannya di sela akselerasi, ingin menyeka noda-noda itu untuk Komandan, tapi keningnya berkerut merasakan suhu dingin begitu jarinya menyentuh dahi itu.)

column1: (If this continues, the Commander will—)
column2: (Kalau begini terus, Komandan akan—)

column1: No... what am I thinking.
column2: Tidak... apa yang kupikirkan.

column1: Commander, you wouldn't be defeated so easily, right?
column2: Komandan, kau tidak akan kalah semudah itu, kan?

column1: Even if you were trapped in an enemy base, you'd calmly maneuver until the very last moment.
column2: Sekalipun terjebak di markas musuh, kau akan bermanuver dengan tenang sampai detik terakhir.

column1: Even if you were severely injured or faced with the most difficult battles, you'd never easily give up halfway through.
column2: Sekalipun terluka parah atau menghadapi pertempuran tersulit, kau tidak akan gampang menyerah di tengah jalan.

column1: So, I will always believe in you, Commander.
column2: Karena itu, aku akan selalu memercayaimu, Komandan.

column1: (Gently touching the Commander's face for a moment, Klukai lowered her hand and continued to twist the throttle to accelerate.)
column2: (Setelah sejenak menyentuh lembut wajah Komandan, Klukai menurunkan tangannya dan kembali memutar gas untuk menambah kecepatan.)

column1: Hmph, thinking about it carefully... you, since the days at Griffin, have always loved causing trouble for others.
column2: Hmph, kalau dipikir-pikir... kau ini, sejak zaman Griffin, memang selalu suka merepotkan orang lain.

column1: Always playing the fool like an idiot, shouldering so many burdens alone, fighting desperately for ethereal ideals and hopes, never sparing a thought for yourself.
column2: Selalu berlagak bodoh seperti orang tolol, memikul begitu banyak beban sendirian, bertempur mati-matian demi cita-cita dan harapan yang samar, tanpa pernah memikirkan dirimu sendiri.

column1: Even after leaving your original position, you're still striving to shoulder everything. You clearly could have lived an easy life, yet you still chose such a difficult path.
column2: Bahkan setelah meninggalkan posisimu yang dulu, kau masih berjuang memikul segalanya. Jelas-jelas kau bisa hidup enak, tapi kau tetap memilih jalan sesulit ini.

column1: However, this is the choice that suits you and 404.
column2: Tapi itulah pilihan yang cocok untukmu dan 404.

column1: Keep shooting! Prepare for secondary bombing!
column2: Terus tembak! Siapkan pengeboman kedua!

column1: (With the shouts coming from afar, bullets pierced the air once again.)
column2: (Bersamaan dengan teriakan dari kejauhan, peluru kembali menembus udara.)

column1: (Klukai, however, turned a blind eye and showed a confident smile, letting the motorcycle speed along.)
column2: (Klukai justru pura-pura tak melihat dan menyunggingkan senyum percaya diri, membiarkan motornya terus melesat.)

column1: That's right, Commander, I won't leave you alone.
column2: Betul, Komandan, aku tidak akan meninggalkanmu sendirian.

column1: Just like I agreed with you before, no matter what kind of obstacles there are, I will overcome them and show you.
column2: Seperti yang sudah kusepakati denganmu dulu, rintangan apa pun itu, akan kutaklukkan dan kutunjukkan padamu.

column1: I will bring you back safely, let you personally put that custom dress I ordered on me, and then go on a date to the place with the best scenery together.
column2: Aku akan membawamu pulang dengan selamat, membiarkanmu sendiri yang memakaikan gaun pesanan khususku, lalu kita berkencan ke tempat berpemandangan terbaik.

column1: We're going to go for a drive together, at the fastest speed. You have to hold me tightly again, just like now.
column2: Kita akan berkendara bersama, dengan kecepatan tertinggi. Kau harus memelukku erat-erat lagi, persis seperti sekarang.

column1: And then... I want you to put the ring on me again.
column2: Lalu... aku mau kau memasangkan cincin itu di jariku lagi.

column1: Hmph, if you don't say anything, I'll take it as you agreeing.
column2: Hmph, kalau kau diam saja, kuanggap kau setuju.

column1: If you dare to go back on your word, I'll stuff you into Sinbreaker, throw you into the big pool on the terrace, and then charge all of Squad 404's expenses for the next quarter to The Elmo's account!
column2: Kalau kau berani menarik ucapanmu, kujejalkan kau ke dalam Sinbreaker, kulempar ke kolam besar di teras, lalu semua pengeluaran Squad 404 kuartal depan kubebankan ke rekening Elmo!

column1: (Amidst the hail of bullets, Klukai freely poured out the heartfelt words she rarely spoke on ordinary days. Although the person in her arms remained silent, she just snorted coldly, raised her head, and accelerated, accelerated, continued to accelerate.)
column2: (Di tengah hujan peluru, Klukai menumpahkan bebas kata-kata dari hati yang jarang dia ucapkan di hari biasa. Meski orang dalam dekapannya tetap diam, dia hanya mendengus dingin, mendongak, lalu menambah kecepatan, menambah kecepatan, terus menambah kecepatan.)

column1: (Pfft! Pfft pfft! Bang bang bang!)
column2: (Cras! Cras cras! Dor dor dor!)

column1: (Another round of gunfire exploded around Klukai. Bullets and sparks constantly damaged her Frame, but she just coldly raised her gun, and bullets ruthlessly sprayed out from the scorching barrel once again.)
column2: (Satu ronde tembakan lagi meledak di sekeliling Klukai. Peluru dan percikan terus merusak Frame-nya, tapi dia hanya mengangkat senjatanya dengan dingin, dan peluru kembali menyembur tanpa ampun dari laras yang membara.)

column1: Heh... a bunch of self-righteous fools, do you think this can trap me?
column2: Heh... sekumpulan orang bodoh yang merasa benar sendiri, kalian pikir ini bisa menjebakku?

column1: Let you blind fools see the true power of an elite Doll!
column2: Biar kalian yang buta ini melihat kekuatan sejati seorang Doll elite!

column1: (Warning, Frame damage rate has reached 62%!)
column2: (Peringatan, tingkat kerusakan Frame mencapai 62%!)

column1: (Warning, Frame damage rate has reached 67%!)
column2: (Peringatan, tingkat kerusakan Frame mencapai 67%!)

column1: (Finally, when the Frame damage rate rose to 72%, a familiar team appeared in Klukai's field of vision.)
column2: (Akhirnya, saat tingkat kerusakan Frame naik ke 72%, sebuah tim yang dikenalnya muncul dalam pandangan Klukai.)

column1: (The blonde Doll in the lead raised her gun and fired rapidly, a flash of red darted into the enemy group, several bullets flew in from afar, accurately intercepting the pursuing enemies, while the Doll in blue, carrying a medical kit, ran desperately toward the motorcycle.)
column2: (Doll berambut pirang di barisan depan mengangkat senjatanya dan menembak cepat, sekelebat merah menerjang ke tengah kerumunan musuh, beberapa peluru melesat dari kejauhan dan tepat mencegat pengejar, sementara Doll berpakaian biru yang menenteng kotak medis berlari sekuat tenaga ke arah motor itu.)

column1: Hmph... finally here... Commander, how was... the joyride this time?
column2: Hmph... akhirnya sampai juga... Komandan, bagaimana... jalan-jalan kali ini?

column1: Next time, you should take more initiative when asking me out.
column2: Lain kali, kau harus lebih inisiatif mengajakku keluar.

column1: (The speeding motorcycle finally came to a halt. Before it could sway and fall over, Klukai lifted her almost completely charred hands, untied the safety straps, and steadily handed the unconscious person in her arms over to the newcomers.)
column2: (Motor yang melesat itu akhirnya berhenti. Sebelum sempat oleng dan roboh, Klukai mengangkat tangannya yang nyaris hangus seluruhnya, melepas sabuk pengaman, dan dengan mantap menyerahkan orang yang tak sadarkan diri dalam dekapannya kepada mereka yang baru datang.)

column1: ...The Commander... is in your hands...
column2: ...Komandan... kuserahkan pada kalian...

column1: (After sending off the Commander and Squad 404, as both the secret tunnels and the surface elevator shafts were captured, more and more conglomerate troops poured into Mokosh.)
column2: (Setelah melepas Komandan dan Squad 404 pergi, dengan terowongan rahasia maupun poros lift permukaan yang sudah direbut, makin banyak pasukan konglomerat membanjir masuk ke Mokosh.)

column1: (Having lost effective command, coupled with continuous combat attrition and the enemy's growing strength, in just a few short hours, Mokosh's resistance front gradually showed signs of collapse.)
column2: (Kehilangan komando yang efektif, ditambah gesekan tempur tanpa henti dan kekuatan musuh yang terus bertambah, hanya dalam beberapa jam, front perlawanan Mokosh perlahan menunjukkan tanda-tanda runtuh.)

column1: Commander, Gate 4 in the central area has also fallen! A large number of enemies are advancing along the central passage, expected to reach the command center in seven minutes!
column2: Komandan, Gerbang 4 di area pusat juga jatuh! Musuh dalam jumlah besar maju lewat lorong pusat, diperkirakan mencapai pusat komando dalam tujuh menit!

column1: Where are the people from the 13th Detachment? The 13th Detachment is in the nearby block, have them fill in!
column2: Mana orang-orang Detasemen 13? Detasemen 13 ada di blok sebelah, suruh mereka menambal!

column1: The 13th Detachment, Captain Rommel and the others, all lost contact fifteen minutes ago...
column2: Detasemen 13, Kapten Rommel dan yang lain, semuanya hilang kontak lima belas menit lalu...

column1: Which squads can still respond to the call now?
column2: Regu mana lagi yang masih bisa menjawab panggilan sekarang?

column1: ...None, sir.
column2: ...Tidak ada, Pak.

column1: All the brothers who can fight are on the front lines, we already... don't have a single spare team left.
column2: Semua saudara yang masih sanggup bertempur ada di garis depan, kita sudah... tidak punya satu pun tim cadangan.

column1: What about the Doll squads? How many people are left in the Doll squads who can respond?
column2: Bagaimana dengan regu Doll? Berapa orang di regu Doll yang masih bisa merespons?

column1: I know, the third-generation Doll squad is blocking the enemy warship's advance, and the Monsoon Squad is currently escorting the evacuating residents with Vasily...
column2: Saya tahu, regu Doll generasi ketiga sedang menahan laju kapal perang musuh, dan Monsoon Squad sedang mengawal warga yang mengungsi bersama Vasily...

column1: Mr. Wulfgar, Cheyanne is online. Aerial fire support has concluded. I have now moved to a sniping position and can provide long-range support for the counterattack.
column2: Pak Wulfgar, Cheyanne tersambung. Dukungan tembakan udara sudah selesai. Saya sudah berpindah ke posisi penembakan dan bisa memberi dukungan jarak jauh untuk serangan balik.

column1: Squad 404 Team 2 is also here...
column2: Squad 404 Tim 2 juga di sini...

column1: Those guys near Passage 2 have been cleared out... Do you need backup for the defense mission at Gate 4?
column2: Musuh di dekat Lorong 2 sudah dibersihkan... Perlu bantuan untuk misi pertahanan di Gerbang 4?

column1: Alright, we'll leave it to you then.
column2: Baiklah, kalau begitu kami serahkan pada kalian.

column1: I... thank you on behalf of my brothers in the Oathguards!
column2: Saya... berterima kasih atas nama saudara-saudara saya di Oathguards!

column1: (Hanging up the communication, Wulfgar takes a deep breath. He rearranges his combat uniform, clips the communication terminal to his waist, and grabs the firearm resting nearby, filling the magazines one by one.)
column2: (Setelah menutup komunikasi, Wulfgar menarik napas dalam. Dia merapikan seragam tempurnya, menjepit terminal komunikasi di pinggang, dan menyambar senjata yang tersandar di dekatnya, mengisi magasin satu per satu.)

column1: Sir, what are you doing?
column2: Pak, Anda mau apa?

column1: To the frontline.
column2: Ke garis depan.

column1: (Wulfgar loads ammo without looking up.)
column2: (Wulfgar mengisi amunisi tanpa mendongak.)

column1: There are no longer any teams that need my command.
column2: Sudah tidak ada lagi tim yang butuh komandoku.

column1: I can't help much on Vasily's side either.
column2: Di pihak Vasily pun aku tidak banyak membantu.

column1: What I can still do now is take all my weapons and resist those bastards destroying our home together with the remaining brothers.
column2: Yang masih bisa kulakukan sekarang adalah membawa semua senjataku dan melawan bajingan-bajingan yang menghancurkan rumah kita, bersama saudara-saudara yang tersisa.

column1: Don't underestimate me, kid. Before coming to Mokosh, I really was a soldier and fought in wars!
column2: Jangan meremehkanku, Nak. Sebelum datang ke Mokosh, aku benar-benar seorang prajurit dan pernah berperang!

column1: (Wulfgar lightly punched the young soldier, said no more, and just grabbed his gun and strode outwards.)
column2: (Wulfgar meninju pelan prajurit muda itu, tak berkata lagi, dan hanya menyambar senjatanya lalu melangkah keluar.)

column1: (The young soldier paused in place, gave Wulfgar a military salute, and also grabbed his gun and followed.)
column2: (Prajurit muda itu terpaku sejenak, memberi hormat militer pada Wulfgar, lalu ikut menyambar senjatanya dan menyusul.)

column1: Sir, I'll go too!
column2: Pak, saya ikut!

column1: Let's show those bastards the power of the Mokosh Defense Forces together!
column2: Ayo kita tunjukkan pada bajingan-bajingan itu kekuatan Pasukan Pertahanan Mokosh!

column1: Passage secure, advance rapidly.
column2: Lorong aman, maju cepat.

column1: (In the passage, a mercenary squad member held his gun and advanced cautiously. Two minutes ago, they successfully broke through the defense of the front gate and smoothly entered the central passage leading to the command building.)
column2: (Di dalam lorong, seorang anggota regu tentara bayaran menggenggam senjatanya dan maju hati-hati. Dua menit lalu, mereka berhasil menembus pertahanan gerbang depan dan mulus masuk ke lorong pusat yang menuju gedung komando.)

column1: (At this moment, seemingly due to a severe shortage of troops, the corridor that should have been strictly guarded is completely empty, with only debris piled up everywhere. The leading member let out a soft sneer.)
column2: (Saat ini, sepertinya karena pasukan sangat kekurangan, koridor yang seharusnya dijaga ketat itu benar-benar kosong, hanya puing yang menumpuk di mana-mana. Anggota di barisan depan mendengus pelan.)

column1: Hmph... It seems Mokosh's defensive forces have reached their limit and won't last much longer.
column2: Hmph... Sepertinya pasukan pertahanan Mokosh sudah mentok dan tidak akan bertahan lama lagi.

column1: Commander Lentine, you might be getting another promotion soon!
column2: Komandan Lentine, sebentar lagi mungkin Anda naik pangkat lagi!

column1: Shh, move quietly. It's too quiet here, the enemy might have an ambush.
column2: Sst, bergerak tanpa suara. Di sini terlalu sepi, musuh mungkin memasang jebakan.

column1: An ambush? Does it look like one to you? The few Oathguards guarding the gate earlier were already out of ammo and supplies, right? They had absolutely no power to resist.
column2: Jebakan? Menurutmu ini kelihatan seperti jebakan? Beberapa Oathguard yang menjaga gerbang tadi sudah kehabisan amunisi dan perbekalan, kan? Mereka sama sekali tidak punya daya untuk melawan.

column1: It's not as simple as you think here. According to the battle report, more than one squad has been here. Given the strength of the remaining Oathguards just now, it should have been breached a long time ago, but we didn't see any other squads.
column2: Di sini tidak sesederhana yang kaupikir. Menurut laporan tempur, lebih dari satu regu sudah masuk ke sini. Dengan kekuatan Oathguard yang tersisa tadi, tempat ini seharusnya sudah lama jebol, tapi kita tidak melihat regu lain satu pun.

column1: Captain, you're just too cautious! If you ask me, the other squads probably went in ages ago. We should march in as soon as possible and take down the command center quickly.
column2: Kapten, Anda terlalu berhati-hati! Menurut saya, regu lain pasti sudah masuk dari tadi. Kita harus segera maju dan cepat merebut pusat komandonya.

column1: (The young member continues to clamor, while the older member shakes his head, ignoring him, and still proceeds cautiously.)
column2: (Anggota muda itu terus berceloteh, sementara anggota yang lebih tua menggeleng, mengabaikannya, dan tetap maju dengan hati-hati.)

column1: (But fortunately, the ambush he was worried about never appeared, at least until they walked into the small hall in front of them—)
column2: (Tapi untungnya, jebakan yang dia cemaskan tak pernah muncul, setidaknya sampai mereka melangkah masuk ke aula kecil di depan—)

column1: Whoa, Captain, this looks like the enemy's material reserve room.
column2: Wah, Kapten, ini kelihatannya ruang cadangan material musuh.

column1: (The young team member stepped forward and checked the supply boxes placed in the four corners of the room. In the boxes, many clothes were piled up messily; beside the boxes, discarded fabrics seemingly used for sheltering from rain or setting up camp were piled all over the floor.)
column2: (Anggota tim yang muda melangkah maju dan memeriksa kotak perbekalan yang diletakkan di empat sudut ruangan. Di dalam kotaknya, banyak pakaian menumpuk berantakan; di sebelah kotak, kain-kain bekas yang tampaknya dipakai untuk berteduh dari hujan atau mendirikan tenda berserakan di seluruh lantai.)

column1: (The member called Captain stepped forward. For some reason, this small hall always made him feel a vague sense of unease, perhaps because too many supply boxes made the passage in and out narrow and difficult to walk, or perhaps because the mountain of fabrics blocked the line of sight.)
column2: (Anggota yang dipanggil Kapten itu melangkah maju. Entah kenapa, aula kecil ini terus membuatnya merasa gelisah samar, mungkin karena terlalu banyak kotak perbekalan sehingga jalan keluar-masuknya sempit dan susah dilewati, atau mungkin karena gunungan kain itu menghalangi pandangan.)

column1: (And his teammates were still curiously rummaging through the suddenly abundant supplies.)
column2: (Dan rekan-rekannya masih sibuk mengobrak-abrik perbekalan yang mendadak melimpah itu karena penasaran.)

column1: Tsk, this box is food. To think there are so many canned tomatoes?
column2: Cih, kotak ini isinya makanan. Tak kusangka ada begitu banyak tomat kalengan?

column1: These guys in the Yellow Zone really live a comfortable life.
column2: Orang-orang Yellow Zone ini hidupnya enak juga rupanya.

column1: Stop rummaging through those boxes, quickly clear a path and keep moving forward!
column2: Berhenti mengobrak-abrik kotak itu, cepat buka jalan dan terus maju!

column1: (The unease in his heart grew. His team had lingered here for far longer than expected.)
column2: (Kegelisahan di hatinya makin menjadi. Timnya sudah berlama-lama di sini jauh melebihi perkiraan.)

column1: (Also, some inexplicable smell seems to faintly linger around him—)
column2: (Selain itu, semacam bau yang sulit dijelaskan seakan menggantung samar di sekitarnya—)

column1: Strange, are these cans of tomatoes leaking? Why are they so sticky...
column2: Aneh, kaleng tomat ini bocor ya? Kok lengket sekali...

column1: Drop the can, lie down quickly!
column2: Buang kalengnya, cepat tiarap!

column1: (Before the Mangi Security squad leader could issue a warning, a bullet had already flown from the distance of the passage, accurately hitting that sticky tomato can.)
column2: (Sebelum ketua regu Mangi Security sempat memberi peringatan, sebutir peluru sudah melesat dari kejauhan lorong dan tepat mengenai kaleng tomat lengket itu.)

column1: (Sizzle—)
column2: (Ssshhh—)

column1: Uwaahhhhh! My hand!
column2: Uwaahhhhh! Tanganku!

column1: (The suddenly ignited tongues of flame licked the young man's palm, and along with the falling cans, rapidly ignited the entire 'sticky' supply box.)
column2: (Lidah api yang tiba-tiba menyala menjilat telapak tangan pemuda itu, dan bersama kaleng-kaleng yang berjatuhan, cepat menyulut seluruh kotak perbekalan yang 'lengket' itu.)

column1: (In just an instant, the room filled with flammables was engulfed by a sea of fire.)
column2: (Hanya dalam sekejap, ruangan yang penuh bahan mudah terbakar itu ditelan lautan api.)

column1: Retreat! Evacuate the room immediately!
column2: Mundur! Segera keluar dari ruangan!

column1: (The soldiers crowded in the room quickly fell back, however, it was already too late.)
column2: (Para prajurit yang berdesakan di ruangan itu cepat mundur, tapi semuanya sudah terlambat.)

column1: (Bang.)
column2: (Dor.)

column1: (Bang bang.)
column2: (Dor dor.)

column1: (A few bullets struck precisely, cutting off their path.)
column2: (Beberapa peluru menghantam tepat sasaran, memutus jalan mereka.)

column1: (And amidst the wildly dancing flames, a more deadly object hidden behind the wooden crates had already been ignited—)
column2: (Dan di tengah kobaran api yang menari liar, benda yang jauh lebih mematikan di balik peti kayu itu sudah tersulut—)

column1: (BOOM!!!)
column2: (BUUM!!!)

column1: (A huge blast wave from the explosion surged over, and the roof and walls collapsed together in the blast wave. The members of the Mangi Security squad trapped in the house were completely engulfed by flames and rubble just like that.)
column2: (Gelombang ledakan yang dahsyat menerjang, dan atap serta dinding runtuh bersamaan dalam gelombang itu. Anggota regu Mangi Security yang terjebak di dalam ruangan ditelan habis oleh api dan reruntuhan begitu saja.)

column1: Phew... were they all cleared out smoothly?
column2: Fiuh... semuanya sudah dibersihkan dengan mulus?

column1: (It wasn't until the firelight in the passage completely dissipated that a Doll leaped out from a hiding place far down the passage. Her body was already covered in bullet holes, and her skin was full of Scorch Marks.)
column2: (Baru setelah kilatan api di lorong itu benar-benar padam, seorang Doll melompat keluar dari persembunyian jauh di ujung lorong. Tubuhnya sudah penuh lubang peluru, dan kulitnya dipenuhi Scorch Marks.)

column1: ...Great. The fourth batch of enemies is also taken care of.
column2: ...Bagus. Gelombang musuh keempat juga sudah beres.

column1: Almost fell into a desperate situation, fortunately the previous arrangements all came in handy.
column2: Nyaris terjebak dalam situasi tanpa harapan, untung semua persiapan sebelumnya berguna.

column1: (Cheyanne gently rubbed her charred hands and once again tightly gripped the nearly scalding sniper rifle.)
column2: (Cheyanne mengusap pelan tangannya yang hangus dan kembali menggenggam erat senapan runduk yang nyaris melepuh itu.)

column1: (Previously, after the Oathguards in front lost their position and the subsequent Oathguards were unable to support, Cheyanne came to this hidden passage and used various residual materials near the passage to build this counterattack position—)
column2: (Sebelumnya, setelah Oathguards di depan kehilangan posisinya dan Oathguards berikutnya tak sanggup membantu, Cheyanne datang ke lorong tersembunyi ini dan memakai berbagai sisa material di sekitar lorong untuk membangun posisi serangan balik ini—)

column1: (Using a defense that could be easily broken through as bait, and messily piled supplies as cover, new enemies were attracted. Relaxed, they stepped deeper into the trap step by step, becoming her prey.)
column2: (Memakai pertahanan yang gampang ditembus sebagai umpan, dan perbekalan yang ditumpuk berantakan sebagai penyamaran, musuh baru terpancing. Dengan santai mereka melangkah makin dalam ke jebakan itu selangkah demi selangkah, menjadi mangsanya.)

column1: (Just like this, with the help of this temporary "hunting ground", Cheyanne, hiding in the distance, knocked down several batches of infiltrating enemy troops. She retrieved supplies from their hands, replenished her reserves, and arranged this "hunting ground" even more perfectly.)
column2: (Begitulah, dengan bantuan "lahan buruan" darurat ini, Cheyanne yang bersembunyi di kejauhan menumbangkan beberapa gelombang pasukan musuh yang menyusup. Dia mengambil perbekalan dari tangan mereka, mengisi ulang cadangannya, dan menata "lahan buruan" ini jadi lebih sempurna lagi.)

column1: (But even so, after round after round of combat, her reserved bullets were almost exhausted. Even those few shots just now were the last spare bullets she dared to use cautiously only after confirming that the battlefield arrangement could take effect.)
column2: (Tapi meski begitu, setelah ronde demi ronde pertempuran, cadangan pelurunya nyaris habis. Bahkan beberapa tembakan tadi adalah sisa peluru terakhir yang baru berani dia pakai hati-hati setelah memastikan penataan medan tempurnya akan berhasil.)

column1: (However, she had now taken down a squad and destroyed an important passage. With many downed enemies ahead, she would definitely be able to find new ammo.)
column2: (Namun sekarang dia sudah menumbangkan satu regu dan menghancurkan sebuah lorong penting. Dengan banyaknya musuh yang tumbang di depan, dia pasti bisa menemukan amunisi baru.)

column1: (Cheyanne cautiously and swiftly advanced towards the collapsed passage, and sure enough, she soon found several submachine guns that had been blasted to her feet.)
column2: (Cheyanne bergerak hati-hati sekaligus gesit ke arah lorong yang runtuh itu, dan benar saja, tak lama dia menemukan beberapa pistol mitraliur yang terlempar ledakan sampai ke kakinya.)

column1: (Although it wasn't the gun type she was most proficient with, it could at least be used for combat.)
column2: (Meski bukan jenis senjata yang paling dia kuasai, setidaknya masih bisa dipakai bertempur.)

column1: Good. Now I can continue fighting.
column2: Bagus. Sekarang aku bisa terus bertempur.

column1: (Cheyanne bent down to pick up the gun, but before she could chamber a round, she was interrupted by incoming bullets.)
column2: (Cheyanne membungkuk memungut senjata itu, tapi sebelum sempat memasukkan peluru ke kamar, dia diinterupsi peluru yang datang.)

column1: ...Oh my.
column2: ...Aduh.

column1: (She turned her head. On the other side of the blown-up passage, a new squad had appeared again at some point.)
column2: (Dia menoleh. Di seberang lorong yang meledak itu, entah sejak kapan sebuah regu baru sudah muncul lagi.)

column1: (More than a dozen fully armed Mangi Security members were hiding behind the ruins of the explosion, raising their guns at her.)
column2: (Lebih dari selusin anggota Mangi Security bersenjata lengkap bersembunyi di balik reruntuhan ledakan, mengarahkan senjata mereka padanya.)
Fuuh——

column1: (Cheyanne tightly gripped the submachine gun in her hand.)
column2: (Cheyanne menggenggam erat pistol mitraliur di tangannya.)

column1: (Like the human she admired the most, she tried hard to regulate her breathing and stay calm, then slowly raised her gun to face the enemy group behind the ruins.)
column2: (Seperti manusia yang paling dia kagumi, dia berusaha keras mengatur napasnya dan tetap tenang, lalu perlahan mengangkat senjatanya menghadap kerumunan musuh di balik reruntuhan.)

column1: This time, it seems I have to fight alone to the end again.
column2: Kali ini sepertinya aku harus bertempur sendirian sampai akhir lagi.

column1: Please lend me some strength, Commander.
column2: Tolong pinjamkan aku sedikit kekuatan, Komandan.
